overall_reason: Operator screenshot on 2026-11-13 shows "At least one of your resource or behavior packs failed to load." and "Unknown command: skinmenu:open". The pack did not load, so no menu or appearance criterion could be reached. A fix has been built but is NOT yet verified on a client.

channel_diagnostics.how_to_read: If the chat reply says the look was set but nothing renders, both channels wrote successfully and the render controller is the failing layer. If the chat reply says the client refused the change, both write channels failed.

fallback_if_C1_fails: Switch to a wearable full-body attachable that hides the player's skin layers via scripts.parent_setup. Documented in RESEARCH.md; not built.

evidence.shows: Two red chat errors: pack failed to load, and unknown command skinmenu:open.

fix_attempt.confirmed_bug: system.beforeEvents.startup subscription was only guarded inside its callback; on a client lacking that API the property access threw at module load and killed every trigger including chat.
